revisedDraft:
In June 2025, Halden Group made a lead commitment to Meridian Capital Partners V, a EUR 1.2 billion fund targeting lower-mid-market buyouts in European industrial technology and business services.

Halden Group was attracted to Meridian on the strength of a track record of 2.4x realised gross MOIC and 21% gross IRR across 17 fully realised deals.

It has realised a gross MOIC of 2.4 times across 17 exits on fully realised deals.

The team's stability, with no senior departures across the last three fund cycles, supports a lower level of key-person risk for the strategy.

Fund IV is currently marked at 1.9 times gross MOIC and a 24% gross IRR.

Meridian Capital Partners V is a EUR 1.2 billion fund targeting lower-mid-market buyouts in European industrial technology and business services.

The fund will hold investments for four to six years and will not deploy more than 30% of commitments outside the EU.

On balance, Halden Group believes the fund should deliver returns broadly in line with its predecessor and views the proposed allocation as appropriate for the portfolio.

The GP has provided access to co-investments on a no-fee, no-carry basis across Funds III and IV to Halden Group and other LPs.

Halden Group expects the relationship to deepen over the life of the fund.
